verdict.rationale: Archived docs once described Smithery running OAuth flows (with OAuth apps it maintained), storing credentials in encrypted write-only storage, and refreshing tokens automatically. Smithery's own shutdown notice says the API, Connect, accounts, and API keys stopped working on October 31, 2026, and that it remains only a non-proxied public registry. The product therefore no longer delivers managed OAuth, credential vaulting, or token refresh.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the platform run OAuth flows for downstream tools and vault the resulting credentials encrypted, with automatic token refresh
